CortexClearBuilding resume reconstructs per-actor visits from separately delivered receipts. Shared cleared indices alone do not prove which worker physically participated.
The prior room component preserved shared progress only. The current pure serializer also copies original entered actor identities and private keyed visit lists, refusing inconsistencies.
implementation: Room journal version2 appends enteredActors and actorVisitRows[actorNetId,indices], retaining the original ordered positions/context and six shared room progress fields. Private outgoing capture becomes version4, retaining its ten outer fields.

At most64 entered actors/map rows; unique original actor objects and netIds; map keys exactly match entered IDs; each nonempty unique visit list is bounded by room count and references only physically cleared indices. No actor is granted participation based on another actor's shared coverage.

Capture remains ENTRY/SWEEP only through existing FROZEN authority. Dead actors with retained object identity may be represented; deleted/identity-less entered actors refuse capture rather than being silently dropped or attributed to a replacement.
cost: One bounded visit-map validation/copy at actual outgoing locality loss. No changed callback cadence, public writes, scan, native command, timestamp or worker. Per-actor retained lists may cover512 rooms for64 historical actors; actual cost/5percent median/10percent p95 remains unmeasured.
remaining: Deleted original identity needs a separately retained stable identity/provenance solution before general handover can claim completeness.
